title: Graphic primitive afb.gp.v2
description: The AFB graphic-primitive entity (the only one; afb.gp.v1 was removed). Notable points: (1) the instrument is identified by the full composite `instrument_key` (afbws/common.v1.json#/$defs/instrumentKey) instead of the short `ticker`; (2) new kinds `trendline` and `fibonacci` — both two-anchor primitives; their rendering is not specified yet; (3) the primitive's own parameters (`start`, `stop`, `text`) live in the `settings` dictionary, not at the root, so a kind can gain parameters without touching the envelope. ROOT = identity and server-side ownership: `schema`, `id`, `instrument_key`, `kind`, `tradeplan_id` (all other parameters go to `settings`). `settings` is REQUIRED and strictly typed by `kind` (enforced by the `allOf` below, each branch is additionalProperties:false): line/line_enter/line_sl/line_tp → `primitiveSettingsLine` {start}; note → `primitiveSettingsNote` {start, text? (≤160)}; zone/ruler/trendline/fibonacci → `primitiveSettingsTwoPoint` {start, stop}. The former v1 (`afb.gp.v1`, flat start/stop/text) has been removed. Promotes the parked settings.primitives[secid][] draft (draft/primitive.v1.json) into a strict canonical entity. Whether a primitive is REFERENCED BY a tradeplan's condition is still derived fresh from the tradeplans themselves on every read, never persisted here. OWNERSHIP is different and is persisted — see `tradeplan_id`.

settings.description: Primitive parameters, strictly typed by `kind` (see root description). Replaced as a whole on `set`.

tradeplan_id.description: Владеющий торговый план. Проставляется сервером при компиляции плана в сделку (публикация/amend); снимается только при физическом удалении плана. Клиент это поле не задаёт и не меняет — в set-запросе оно игнорируется в пользу хранимого значения. Пустое/отсутствующее — свободный примитив, доступный любому плану. При архивации плана его уровни физически удаляются из этого хранилища, но условия плана НЕ переписываются в числа — план сохраняет исходные ссылки на примитивы; полная копия каждого удалённого уровня (kind/координаты/стиль) переносится в archived_components плана и является источником его исторической отрисовки.

indicatorSettings.description: Display + calculation settings. Required: color/lineWidth/lineStyle. Typed optional keys of the built-in indicators: period (wma, cot); erPeriod/fastPeriod/slowPeriod (kama); start/maximum/increment (psar). Any other key is allowed (value: number, string or boolean), except `enabled` (per-device view flag, never protocol) — indicators are computed by the frontend, so a new indicator brings its own parameters without a protocol change. Mirrors IndicatorInstance.settings of the frontend chart and `indicators[].settings` of config/_default_.yaml, without the on/off flag.

indicator.title: Chart indicator (user or shared)
indicator.description: `scope: shared` indicators are common to all users and editable only by a manager; `personal` belong to the caller. `settings` carry the parameters. Whether an indicator is shown on the chart is not part of the protocol (per-device view setting kept in the client's localStorage). `type` is an open string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`), not an enum; the server computes only wma/kama/psar (alarm indicator conditions, virtual account), other types are stored and returned as is. Type `cot` is chart-only.

type.description: Indicator type, an open set: indicators are computed by the frontend, so a new indicator needs no protocol change. Known: wma, kama, psar, cot.

datasetRef.title: Reference to a primary-data field of a dataset.
datasetRef.description: Grammar: `candles` (the candle series OHLC pseudo-field; price unit, pane `price` only, at most one per preset) | `<source>.<field>` | `<source>.<field>@median(N)` | `<source>.<field>@window(N)`. `@median(N)` is the rolling median of the field in calendar days (same meaning as in afbws/market.channel.v2.json#/$defs/fieldRequest); `@window(N)` is a window of N bars of the chart period, allowed only for fields flagged `window` in `fields.v2` and mandatory for them, N in 2..`window_max_bars` (e.g. `positions.willco@window(180)`). The pattern checks the shape only; the real bounds of N and the existence of the field are enforced by the server registry.

datasetStyle.title: Display style of a dataset or a preset item.
datasetStyle.description: All keys are optional, unknown keys are rejected. Keys by kind of series: line-like (everything except `candles`) — `seriesType` (Line|Histogram|Area|Baseline), `color`, `lineWidth` (1..4, meaningful for Line/Area/Baseline), `lineStyle` (0..4, lightweight-charts numbering: 0 Solid, 1 Dotted, 2 Dashed, 3 LargeDashed, 4 SparseDotted; meaningful for Line/Area/Baseline); candles — `upColor`, `downColor`, `wickUpColor`, `wickDownColor`. This schema allows all keys together; whether the keys fit the kind of the series (candle keys on a non-`candles` dataset, `seriesType`/`color`/`lineWidth`/`lineStyle` on `candles`) is checked by the server (`validation_error`). In `$defs/dataset` the style is COMPLETE (the server requires all four candle colours for `candles`, and `seriesType`, `color`, `lineWidth`, `lineStyle` for the others). In a preset item it holds only OVERRIDES: effective style = dataset style overlaid with the item's keys; resetting a key means removing it.

dataset.title: Dataset of a chart (user-visible primary-data series)
dataset.description: A primary-data field (or the candle series) that staff made available, with a name and a default style. `scope: personal` is a DRAFT: visible to its author (staff) only, never pushed; `scope: shared` is published, visible to everyone by `name`, changed and deleted by staff only. A shared preset may reference shared datasets only. `unit` is filled by the server from the field registry and is ignored in `set`. `style` is the complete default style (see `$defs/datasetStyle`); the kind-vs-keys check is done by the server.

unit.description: Unit of the field's values, set by the server from the registry; ignored in `set`.

datasetRejection.title: One dataset that was not applied by dataset.set/dataset.delete.

preset.title: Chart preset (user or shared)
preset.description: A set of datasets with a binding `which dataset is drawn on which pane`. `scope: shared` presets are common to all users and editable only by staff; `personal` belong to the caller. `panes` has three panes: `price` (the candle pane), `upper` and `lower` (the two extra panes); each is an array of at most 16 `presetItem`s, the ORDER is the draw and legend order. Pane rules (checked by the server in `preset.set`, `validation_error` otherwise; the frontend checks them too): `price` accepts only datasets of price scale class; `candles` only on `price`, at most one per preset; on `upper`/`lower` one scale class per pane (the class of the first item); a dataset occurs in a preset at most once. Referenced datasets must exist and be visible to the author; a shared preset may reference shared datasets only. WMA/KAMA/PSAR indicators are drawn on `price` over the candles outside the preset.

presetItem.title: One dataset placed on a pane of a preset.
presetItem.description: `dataset` is the id of a dataset (`$defs/dataset.id`); `style` holds only OVERRIDES of the dataset's default style, with keys valid for the dataset's kind (checked by the server); absent = the dataset's own style.

primitiveKindStyle.title: Display style of one primitive kind.

color.description: hex colour; for `note` the callout line / frame / text colour.

lineStyle.description: lightweight-charts LineStyle: 0 Solid, 1 Dotted, 2 Dashed, 3 LargeDashed, 4 SparseDotted.

primitiveStyles.title: Per-user display styles of primitives by kind (afbws.gp.style.v2).
primitiveStyles.description: Keys are primitive kinds; a kind that is absent has no stored override (the client falls back to its defaults).
